title: UI: Fix global shortcuts not showing region focus indicator
body:
## What I did

Follow up on issue found in 10.3 QA: the focus indicator for sidebars and addon panels showed when pressing their respective "show sidebar/panel" buttons but not when using the global keyboard shortcuts.

## Checklist for Contributors


#### Manual testing

* Close the sidebar and addon panel
* Press Alt+A or Alt+S (note that these don't work when focus is inside the preview)

Sidnioulz
comments.body:
This sounds reasonable but there's a subtlety here: `forceFocus` plays a different role (it adds tabindex if needed to absolutely ensure focus does happen on keyboard-only workflows).

I don't remember why I set `forceFocus` to false on mouse clicks though. Probably has to do with avoiding a focus indicator appearing on clicks.

Where possible, we still want to focus on mouse clicks because hybrid mouse+kb usage benefits from keeping focus position somewhat logical.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body:
Same issue as the menu tool: `focusOnUIElement` is invoked with `forceFocus: false` and `poll: true` on the mouse-click path, which will poll for up to 500ms even though the addon panel region isn’t normally focusable (so focus won’t succeed without `forceFocus`). Skip focusing when `forceFocus` is false or disable polling for that path to avoid unnecessary intervals.
```suggestion
      poll: forceFocus,
```
